corrections.before: Any regular-symbol win starts three cloud shifts.
corrections.after: Any non-Scatter win starts three cloud shifts.

corrections.before: All symbols move up one cell. Only the new bottom row is drawn. Each shifted board pays once.
corrections.after: Open cells move up one position; draw a new bottom symbol on each reel. Closed cells stay unchanged. Each board pays once.

corrections.before: Each reel containing a WILD becomes entirely WILD. Only the increase over the original award pays.
corrections.after: All open cells on a reel containing an open WILD become WILD. Closed cells stay unchanged. Pay only the award increase.

corrections.before: All coins become the same randomly selected regular symbol. Awards start from the right edge. Pay only the increase.
corrections.after: Open coins become one randomly selected regular symbol. Evaluate Ways from the left; pay only the award increase.

animation: New symbols enter opposite to the actual movement direction.
closedCells: Preserved during rising shifts and expansion, excluded from animation focus, masked above moving symbols.
